instruction: A candid martial arts photograph shows a full shot of two men on a black mat inside a studio with a textured brown wall. On the left, the man in the white gi (R1) is kneeling, looking down at his partner's hand. On the right, the man in the gray gi (R2) kneels opposite him, extending his arm to grip the white gi's collar. They engage in a controlled kneeling drill, focused on grip fighting. Warm, soft indoor lighting casts gentle shadows across the wooden floor.
